_comment: One campus tree walk: the eight curated field-guide species that have artwork, visited in the order with the shortest total walk over the footpath-weighted routing grid (exhaustive over all 8! orders, 1,263 m on 2026-10-01). Each stop sits on the app's demo encounter point for that species (src/data.ts encounter_seed) — a place on this map to look for the species, NOT a surveyed tree, so is_position_surveyed is false on every stop. The 'where' names came with the old hand-drawn map and are not re-surveyed, so they are is_named_by_us. The look_for lines are ours: general field marks of the species, not a description of the tree at the stop. See README.md here to add a trail anywhere.
title: Campus tree walk
blurb: Eight trees from the field guide, from the CTC quad round to Berchmans, mostly on footpaths.
author: Magisphere team

stop.look_for: A wide umbrella crown; the leaflets fold shut before rain and at dusk.
Scaly brown-grey bark, glossy compound leaves, and woody seed capsules on the ground.
Roots that climb and wrap: a strangler fig began on another tree.
Large, deeply veined, toothed leaves; a round green fruit wrapped in fleshy sepals.
A shrub, not a tree: five-fingered leaves, pale beneath, and small lilac flowers.
Flaking pale bark and leaves in threes or opposite pairs.
Drooping branches, and in season, flat round winged pods.
A tall buttressed trunk; big compound leaves crowded at the branch tips.
